default.notes: A visa must be obtained in advance from a Sudanese embassy, normally with a local sponsor or agency invitation — but the civil war has suspended most tourist issuance and many Sudanese missions abroad have scaled back visa services.

EG.notes: Egyptians have historically entered visa-free under bilateral agreements, though men of working age have needed prior clearance — confirm current wartime practice before travel.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are not admitted to Sudan, and evidence of travel to Israel in any passport can also lead to refusal.

SD.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Sudanese citizens.
